$comment: The social pack: every image, the source it is drawn from, the PNG files it is given and the platform rule each file answers to; the repository cards; the README banners; what is not made, and why; the previews. tools/export.py reads this file and writes the README's tables from it. Rules were read on the day each one states, at the address it states.

words.line: Your passwords, on a board you already own.
words.from: The hero line of kleidos.dev, as brand/press-kit/src/press.json holds it (words.en.title).

youtube-avatar.formats: JPG, GIF (not animated), BMP or PNG
youtube-avatar.crop: a circle; shown at 98 x 98 on the channel page and smaller beside videos and comments
youtube-avatar.safe_zone: the square inside the circle (566 x 566 at 800)
youtube-avatar.notes: The page gives the formats, the 15 MB limit and the 98 x 98 render size, and no upload size; 800 x 800 is kept from the first pack.

youtube-banner.formats: JPG, GIF (not animated), BMP or PNG
youtube-banner.crop: TV shows all of it; a computer a band up to 2560 x 423; a tablet 1855 x 423; a phone 1546 x 423
youtube-banner.safe_zone: 1546 x 423 at (507, 508): the area every device shows
youtube-banner.notes: Minimum 2048 x 1152 at 16:9; at that size the safe area for text and logos is 1235 x 338, which is 1546 x 423 at the recommended 2560 x 1440.

youtube-watermark.formats: PNG, GIF (not animated), BMP or JPG
youtube-watermark.crop: none; shown small in a corner of the player, over the video
youtube-watermark.notes: Minimum 150 x 150, square, less than 1 MB. Transparent, so the video shows around the mark and between its ring and its body.

youtube-thumbnail.crop: none; the duration badge covers the bottom right corner and the progress bar the bottom edge
youtube-thumbnail.safe_zone: 3456 x 1720 at (192, 160), clear of the badge and the bar
youtube-thumbnail.where: with each video, in its details
youtube-thumbnail.notes: 3840 x 2160, at least 640 wide, 16:9. The limit is 2 MB from a phone and 50 MB from a computer; the stricter one is kept.

makertube-avatar.crop: a circle; stored at 1500, 600, 120 and 48 px square
makertube-avatar.notes: ACTOR_IMAGES_SIZE and CONSTRAINTS_FIELDS.ACTORS.IMAGE in PeerTube's source. The instance's own configuration was read for the first pack on 2026-11-10 and gave the same limits; it was not read again.

makertube-banner.crop: stored at 1920 x 317 and 600 x 100; a narrow page shows the middle
makertube-banner.notes: The same constants as the avatar.

github-card.crop: none on GitHub; some sites that show the link crop it to 1.91:1, centered
github-card.safe_zone: 2240 x 1024 at (160, 128), inside the centered 1.91:1 crop
github-card.where: the repository's Settings, General, Social preview
github-card.notes: Under 1 MB; at least 640 x 320, 1280 x 640 for best display; a solid background is recommended. Twice the recommended size, by the owner's decision.

github-readme.formats: SVG, PNG, JPG or GIF, referenced from the README
github-readme.crop: none; shown as wide as the README's column: 823 to 838 px on a computer, 279 to 349 px on a phone
github-readme.where: the repository's README.md, above its first heading
github-readme.notes: The widths and GitHub's page grounds (#ffffff light, #0d1117 dark) were measured on github.com on the day read, logged out; the 500 kB limit is this pack's own.

images.what: the mark alone on the stage ground, its ring filling the square every circle crop keeps
the lockup, the hero line and the nine boards at one scale on a shelf, each on its unlock screen, inside the area every device shows; ground everywhere else
the mark alone on transparency, for the corner of the player
the thumbnail template: the lockup, a title a video replaces, and room at the right for its picture
the lockup and the hero line on one row, inside the central band

not_made.why: The organization already has its picture; it moves here when the profile's banner does.
No Short and no end screen is planned; each is a source, a row and an export the day one is.
A video's thumbnail is made with the video; the YouTube template at half size serves until then.

previews.title: Every PNG of the pack
previews.lede: Each exported file, scaled to fit, with its path, its pixels and its weight. The watermark is transparent and sits on a tile.

previews.title: The avatar, as each platform crops it
previews.lede: In a circle at the sizes YouTube and MakerTube show it, on a dark and on a light page, and the small ones again with each pixel enlarged four times.

previews.title: The YouTube banner, device by device
previews.lede: What a TV, a computer, a tablet and a phone show of the one file, at half its pixels.

previews.title: The MakerTube banner, both stored sizes
previews.lede: The 1920 x 317 file at two thirds of its pixels, and the 600 x 100 copy PeerTube also stores, pixel for pixel.

previews.title: The repository cards
previews.lede: Each card at half its pixels, at the 640, 400 and 320 px a page or a chat shows it, and in the centered 1.91:1 crop some sites apply. The last one is the template, with a placeholder name.

previews.title: The README banners
previews.lede: Each banner in both themes on GitHub's two page grounds, as wide as a README shows it on a computer (823 px) and on a phone (279 px), and the phone's again with each pixel enlarged twice.
